President Donald Trump said that the U.S. lost semiconductor manufacturing to Taiwan and other countries and lauded his efforts to bring chip production back to America.



Trump took to Truth Social early Thursday and highlighted the partnerships he facilitated between Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC), Nvidia Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA)
